User.title: User
User.description: Represents detailed user profile, registration, subscription and payment status info

uid.description: The unique Firebase Authentication user ID

email.description: The primary email address of the registered user

companyName.description: The company name associated with the user

phone.description: The contact phone number of the user

plan.description: The name or type of the active plan

subscriptionStatus.description: The current status of the subscription

subscriptionExpiry.description: The date and time when the subscription expires

paymentStatus.description: The status of the user's payment

updatedAt.description: The timestamp of the last update to the user profile

TrialClaim.title: Trial Claim
TrialClaim.description: Records representing a claim of free 1-day trial by email or device fingerprint

email.description: The Google email of the trial user

fingerprint.description: Visitor device fingerprint to prevent multiple accounts

ipAddress.description: The IP address of the claiming client

validUntil.description: Expiration time of the trial (1 day later)

UserSession.title: User Session
UserSession.description: Represents active user subscription or trial state and access expiry

expiryDate.description: ISO timestamp indicating when access expires

users/{userId}.description: Collection of user documents keyed by their Firebase Auth UID

trials/{trialId}.description: Collection tracking trial usages to block duplicates

sessions/{sessionId}.description: Collection keeping track of active user access and expiry dates
